Here is an exhaustive, pixel-perfect specification for the **MTQΣ** dark fintech landing-page strip. ### 1. Global Layout & Container * **Viewport:** Full-width, fixed height (approx. **720px–800px** for this hero section). * **Background:** Deep space black with subtle radial vignette. * **Base Color:** `#020617` (Slate-950) to `#0A0F1E`. * **Vignette:** Radial gradient centered behind the globe, fading from `rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.15)` (transparent blue) at center to `#000000` at edges. * **Grid System:** * **Max-Width:** `1280px` or `1440px`, centered. * **Padding-X:** `24px` (mobile) / `48px` (desktop). * **Padding-Y (Nav):** `20px` top/bottom. --- ### 2. Navigation Bar (Top Strip) **Position:** Fixed or sticky at top, `z-index: 50`. | Element | Specification | | :--- | :--- | | **Logo (Left)** | **Icon:** Circle badge (see Section 3).
**Text:** `MTQΣ`
• Font: **Inter** or **Space Grotesk**, Weight **800** (ExtraBold).
• Size: **24px**.
• Color: `#FFFFFF`.
• Letter-spacing: `-0.02em` (tight).
• Spacing from icon: `12px`. | | **Nav Links (Center)** | **Items (L→R):** `Home` • `Product` • `Ecosystem` • `Developers` • `Governance` • `Resources`
• Font: **Inter**, Weight **500** (Medium).
• Size: **14px**.
• Color: `#94A3B8` (Slate-400) → Hover: `#FFFFFF`.
• Spacing: `32px` gap between items.
• **Active State (`Home`):** Color `#FFFFFF`. Bottom border: **2px solid #3B82F6** (Blue-500), offset `-24px` from text baseline, width matching text. | | **Chain Selector** | **Icon:** Small green dot (`#10B981`) + `Monad` text.
• Font: **Inter**, Weight **500**, Size **14px**.
• Color: `#E2E8F0`.
• UI: Chevron down icon (`↓`), color `#64748B`.
• Padding: `8px 12px`. | | **CTA Button (Right)** | **Label:** `Connect Wallet`
• Background: **Linear Gradient 135deg** from `#38BDF8` (Sky-400) to `#8B5CF6` (Violet-500).
• Text: **Inter**, Weight **600**, Size **14px**, Color `#FFFFFF`.
• Padding: `10px 24px`.
• Border-Radius: **9999px** (Full Pill).
• Shadow: `0 4px 15px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4)` (Purple glow).
• Hover: Slight brightness increase (`brightness(1.1)`). | --- ### 3. Logo / Coin Badge (The "M" Icon) * **Shape:** Perfect circle, **32px × 32px**. * **Background:** Linear gradient **135deg** from `#3B82F6` (Blue-500) top-left to `#8B5CF6` (Violet-500) bottom-right. * **Border:** `2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)` (subtle inner highlight). * **Inner Glyph:** Stylized "M" or Sigma (Σ) symbol. * Color: `#FFFFFF`. * Style: Geometric, sharp angles. * Centered within the circle. --- ### 4. Hero Content (Lower Section) #### A. Tagline Badge (Upper Left of Hero) * **Container:** Glassmorphism pill. * **Background:** `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)`. * **Border:** `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`. * **Backdrop-filter:** `blur(12px)`. * **Border-Radius:** `9999px` (Pill). * **Padding:** `8px 16px`. * **Display:** Inline-flex, align-center, gap `8px`. * **Content:** * **Icon:** Small sparkle/star (`✦`), color `#38BDF8` (Sky-400), size `14px`. * **Text:** `The Next Generation Monetary Protocol` * Font: **Inter**, Weight **500**, Size **13px**. * Color: `#CBD5E1` (Slate-300). * Letter-spacing: `0.01em`. #### B. Main Headline * **Text:** ``` A More Stable, Transparent & ``` * **Typography:** * Font: **Inter** (or system-ui sans-serif), Weight **800** (ExtraBold). * Size: **64px** (desktop) / **40px** (mobile). * Line-height: **1.1** (tight). * Color: `#F8FAFC` (Slate-50, near white). * Max-width: `600px` (left-aligned). * Margin-top: `32px` from badge. #### C. Feature Cards (Floating Panels) Two cards positioned to the right of the headline, flanking the central globe graphic. **Card 1: Real-World Asset Backing (Left of Globe)** * **Position:** Absolute/Fixed, roughly `60%` from top, `25%` from left. * **Dimensions:** `~240px` width, auto height. * **Style (Glass Panel):** * **Background:** `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)` (Slate-900/60). * **Border:** `1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1)` (Slate-400/10). * **Border-Radius:** `16px`. * **Backdrop-filter:** `blur(16px)`. * **Padding:** `20px`. * **Shadow:** `0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)`. * **Content:** * **Icon (Top):** Building/Bar chart icon inside a soft blue glow circle (`bg-blue-500/10`, `color:#3B82F6`). Size `24px`. * **Title:** `Real-World Asset Backing` * Font: **Inter**, Weight **600**, Size **15px**, Color `#FFFFFF`. * Margin-top: `12px`. * **Subtitle:** `Tangible. Audited. Secure.` * Font: **Inter**, Weight **400**, Size **13px**, Color `#94A3B8` (Slate-400). * Margin-top: `4px`. **Card 2: AI-Powered Economics (Right of Globe)** * **Position:** Mirror of Card 1, `70%` from top, `75%` from left. * **Style:** Identical to Card 1 (Glass panel, `16px` radius, same border/bg). * **Content:** * **Icon (Top):** Brain/AI neural network icon in cyan/teal glow (`bg-cyan-500/10`, `color:#06B6D4`). Size `24px`. * **Title:** `AI-Powered Economics` * Font: **Inter**, Weight **600**, Size **15px**, Color `#FFFFFF`. * **Subtitle:** `Adaptive. Transparent. Fair.` * Font: **Inter**, Weight **400**, Size **13px**, Color `#94A3B8`. #### D. Central Globe Graphic (Background Element) * **Type:** 3D Wireframe/Terrain Globe (Europe/Africa facing). * **Colors:** * Landmasses: Glowing `#3B82F6` (Blue) with `#06B6D4` (Cyan) highlights. * Grid lines: Subtle `rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3)`. * Atmosphere: Outer glow `rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2)` blending into background. * **Effect:** Floating particles/orbits around the globe (thin glowing ellipses, `#8B5CF6` purple and `#38BDF8` blue, opacity `0.4`). --- ### 5. Spacing & Alignment Summary * **Vertical Rhythm:** * Nav bottom edge → Tagline top: **80px–100px**. * Tagline → Headline: **24px**. * Headline baseline → Cards vertical center: **~40px** overlap (cards sit mid-headline height). * **Horizontal Rhythm:** * Left margin (Headline): Aligned with Logo left edge. * Right margin (Cards): Cards are positioned absolutely, breaking out of the text grid to overlap the globe visual. ### 6. Technical Implementation Notes * **Font Stack:** `font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;` * **Smoothness:** All glass panels use `transform: translateZ(0)` for GPU acceleration. * **Gradients:** Use `background-clip: text` if any text has gradient (though here text is solid white, only the button and logo use gradients). * **Responsive:** Below `768px`, stack headline above globe, move cards below headline as a horizontal scroll or grid. Nav collapses to hamburger.
